4510.title: Image request failures in GitHub PR Markdown
4510.rootCauseOneLine: The GitHub plugin renders raw image URLs without an error fallback; the claimed private-attachment authentication mechanism remains unverified.
4510.proposedFix: Verify private attachment delivery in a controlled repository, then design an access-preserving delivery path and add a failed-image link fallback.
4510.caveats: A synthetic denied image request reproduced the missing fallback, but no private GitHub attachment was tested.
